decision_question: What whole-transaction gas usage and native gas cost does the receipt prove for the one exact event-106981 conversion already retained from a successful bounded log page?
stop_conditions: make exactly one eth_getTransactionReceipt request for the retained transaction hash
persist the raw body before status or payload validation
make no identical retry after any HTTP JSON-RPC parse or receipt error
do not request transaction calldata block timestamp native-token price or account state
warnings: receipt gas covers the whole outer transaction and is not an isolated convertPositions call
historical gas and a non-contemporaneous live book margin cannot prove current realized profit
native gas paid by the outer transaction does not prove the user's relayer charge or account accessibility
